Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 0.3075 +/- 0.0101 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 3252.50 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -2.055, -3.432 mas/yr. entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,626 K and log g 2.315 (u1 0.736, u2 0.067): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
